notes.title: The demo of A Dog of Flanders is now available !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300665/6efa6be9e13fa475d5b67c714c87e73d1127b151.jpg[/img]
The demo of A Dog of Flanders is now available, and it will be featured in the Steam Next Fest this October. We warmly invite you to give it a try!

notes.title: A Dog of Flanders is open for Playtest!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm Watermelon Bug, the developer of A Dogs of Flanders. The Playtest for A Dogs of Flanders is now open for testing without review. The playtest is completely free, covers the game's prologue and first chapter, and is expected to give you a 30-minute to 1-hour gameplay experience. We sincerely look forward to your participation and hope you enjoy the game. We look forward to meeting you in the game!

The Playtest can be accessed from the store page:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300665/0dc996d34a37a8f1ee334594b777c1fd52f4c208.png[/img]

In order to allow players who use English or Japanese to try out the game, I've done a rough localization, if there is something incorrect in the translation, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/uUCDPFrem7]Discord [/url]for feedback!

The main goal of this Playtest is to spread the word about A Dog of Flanders as a game and to take the opportunity to talk to players who have been looking forward to it. It is hoped that this Playtest will identify and fix some of the existing problems in the game.

If you have any questions or problems with this test, please feel free to leave a comment below. I will reply and answer questions as soon as possible. We look forward to your feedback and suggestions.
